Package com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render.camera

Enum Class CubemapFace

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CubemapFace>
com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render.camera.CubemapFace
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CubemapFace>, Constable
public enum CubemapFace extends Enum<CubemapFace>
Canonical order and camera vectors for the six cubemap faces.

The order is part of the qualified skybox layout contract: +X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z. Projection and calibration code relies on these indices staying stable.
